title: Review entry (one block in review.md)
description: Demo variant: the same shape as the real one, with the demo world's people. A review entry is an item inside a container: a head with its attributes, a text below. review.md is the append-only sequence of these entries, newest at the end, never edited afterwards.

id.description: REV-001, REV-002 … — numbered per container, given by the tool, never chosen.

date.description: When the entry was written. Set by the tool.

author.description: Who wrote it — the signed-in person, or the agent instance. Set by the tool from the session.

for.description: Who is asked to act. Absent when the entry is a record and asks nothing of anyone (the file shows '—').

status.description: info: a record, nothing to do. open: needs an answer or a change from `for`. resolved: an earlier open entry is answered — say which in `resolves`. approved: a gate passed (text, assets, recording).

stage.description: The stage folder the container stood in when the entry was written. Set by the tool.

title.description: One line: what this entry is about.

resolves.description: The entry this one answers or corrects. The one relation an entry carries.

text.description: The entry itself, Markdown. Never rewritten.
